data.text/markdown:
One pair, decomposed: the agentic alternative to MOTIVE's one-shot scalar

MOTIVE (Arevalo et al., NeurIPS 2024) scores a compound-gene interaction in one shot - a single non-interactive prediction step: (gene, compound) -> scalar. This notebook does the other thing - (gene, compound) -> a rich, auditable evidence portfolio - for a single worked pair, BRD4 / (+)-JQ1, the famous BET-bromodomain interaction. The point is not to beat MOTIVE's score. With simple, non-leaky signals BRD4/JQ1 is an auditable null: the call comes back "not supported," and the loop names exactly why the evidence is thin - JQ1's JUMP profile is source-7-only (the documented batch-effect source) and BRD4 is common-essential (knockout dependency ~-1 across nearly all cell lines), so there is little differential dependency for a drug-sensitivity correlation to grip. JQ1 is genuinely morphologically active (activity mAP ~1.0), so the weak connectivity is a real result, not a dead profile. The one-shot GNN emits a single scalar (compound AP 0.668) that can express none of this. Decomposability - including an honest "the evidence is thin, and here is which part and why" - is the argument. Below: predictive, non-leaky streams (morphology, DepMap) + the MOTIVE baseline read live, collated into a provisional call. The MOTIVE label key is used only to identify the pair, never as evidence (the leaky column makes that auditable).

data.text/html:
### BRD4 / JQ1

**One-shot baseline (what we contrast against):** MOTIVE one-shot GNN: gene AP **0.341** (deg 6); compound AP **0.668** (deg 3)

**Agentic provisional call:** **not supported by predictive evidence** (confidence: low,
score 0.0/3). Grounds (predictive evidence only - this is what a
judge reads):

- CAVEAT: compound profile is source-7-only (batch-effect source)
  • morphology sign pattern not inhibitor-consistent
  • gene at 50th pct of connectivity (unremarkable)
  • DepMap correlation weak (r=+0.07) - gene is common-essential, so this assay has little differential signal to deconvolve (not evidence against the pair)

data.text/markdown:
Why this answers the one-shot critique

On BRD4/JQ1 the call is "not supported" - and the loop says why: the compound is morphologically active but its profile is source-7-only, and the gene is common-essential so DepMap has little differential dependency to deconvolve. "Active compound + common-essential gene + cross-source caveat = the evidence is genuinely thin, and here is which part" is a stronger thing to hand a scientist than a confident scalar. The GNN's compound AP 0.668 can express none of it. Each row names its source and whether it is leaky (label-bearing) or genuinely predictive, so the leakage audit is free: the predictive streams (morphology, DepMap) never read the MOTIVE label key - that file only identifies the pair. The win condition is that this auditable per-pair analysis can be produced and reads clearly, including where the evidence is weak - not a higher AP. The full three-pair version (with the GNN-missed contrast pairs and the structure-stream stub) is nb44_ss_motive_interaction_evidence.py.
